items.title: Eddie Dawson Interview, 1959-08-11
items.q: that's where Frank Keeling come around. He, but he, now he'd fill in on them little uh, light jobs, you know, like that way, like little fish fries and things like that, you know, to play.

ctx.x: I've seen a picture of that place.

Yeah. Now he had waiters, colored waiters, you know, in both of them places, you see. On Ramport and they had colored waiters over on either, on the base of them. Yeah. Well that was most of the bar room there. Big bar room he had at that corner, you see. Yeah. And they had what uh say like wine rooms, you know, in the back. You know, had little boots, you see, for private people to go in and sit for the curtains like that. But we'd sit in the back on the corner and entertain, you know. Then Tom Brown would open…
Are there any other bands there on your list that we neglected to ask about?
